{{Top|leg}}
'''Miims''' were creatures native to [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. They were used by the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]] as beasts of burden.

Many male [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]] were named for this species.
